parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: ProcessActionEnd
parameters.description: The end time of the query for response tasks. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp.

parameters.name: ProcessActionStart
parameters.description: The start time of the query for response tasks. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The user ID of the member to which the administrator switches the view.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The view type. Valid values:

- 0 (default): the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.
- 1: the view of all accounts in the enterprise.
